title: Enhance Add Account Dialog with Live Search, Custom Prop Firm Addition, and Fix Submission Error

requirements.summary: Implement live search functionality in AddAccountDialog prop firm dropdown that filters firms as user types with case-insensitive partial matching
acceptanceCriteria: Search input field appears above or within the prop firm dropdown
Typing in search box immediately filters displayed prop firms
Search matches partial strings anywhere in firm name (case-insensitive)
Empty search shows all 55+ firms from PROP_FIRMS constant
Clear search functionality resets filter to show all firms

file_operations.description: Add live search input field above the prop firm Select component. Implement useState for search term and useMemo to filter firms from PROP_FIRMS constant based on case-insensitive partial match. Update Select component to display filtered results. Include clear search button that resets filter.

requirements.summary: Add 'Add your Prop firm' option in AddAccountDialog that allows users to manually enter custom prop firm names
acceptanceCriteria: 'Add your Prop firm' option is visible in the dropdown or as a separate action button
Clicking the option opens an input field or inline form to enter custom firm name
User can type any custom prop firm name without validation constraints
Custom firm name is immediately available for selection in current session

file_operations.description: Add 'Add your Prop firm' option at the top of the filtered prop firm list. When clicked, show an inline input field with confirm/cancel buttons below the search box. On confirm, add the custom firm to a local state array and merge with PROP_FIRMS for display. Allow immediate selection of the newly added custom firm in the dropdown.

requirements.summary: Store custom prop firms in backend user profile and cache them in frontend localStorage for persistence across sessions and devices
acceptanceCriteria: Backend actor method in main.mo saves custom prop firm names to user profile in stable storage
Custom firms are associated with the authenticated user's principal
Frontend stores custom firms in localStorage after successful backend save
On component mount, AddAccountDialog loads custom firms from localStorage and merges with PROP_FIRMS constant
Custom firms persist across browser sessions and device logins
Duplicate custom firm names are prevented

file_operations.description: Create custom mutation hook that calls actor.addCustomPropFirm() to save a custom prop firm name to the backend. On success, update the cached user profile query to include the new custom firm. Handle duplicate firm name validation by checking against existing custom firms from the user profile.

Import useGetCallerUserProfile hook to fetch user profile containing customPropFirms array. Import useAddCustomPropFirm hook for saving new custom firms. On component mount, merge customPropFirms from user profile with PROP_FIRMS constant. When user adds a custom firm, call useAddCustomPropFirm mutation and also cache the firm in localStorage under key 'customPropFirms'. On mount, check localStorage for customPropFirms and merge with profile data as fallback. Prevent duplicate firm names by checking both PROP_FIRMS and existing customPropFirms before allowing addition.

Create utility functions for localStorage operations: saveCustomPropFirm(firmName: string), getCustomPropFirms(): string[], and clearCustomPropFirms(). Implement duplicate checking logic. Handle JSON parsing errors gracefully.

requirements.summary: Fix dropdown scrolling issue in AddAccountDialog where prop firm dropdown does not scroll properly through the list
acceptanceCriteria: Dropdown properly displays vertical scrollbar when firm list exceeds visible height
Mouse scroll and keyboard arrow keys navigate through full list of firms
Dropdown height is constrained to reasonable maximum (e.g., 300-400px)
Selected firm remains visible when dropdown closes
Dropdown z-index ensures it appears above other form elements

file_operations.description: Update the Select component's SelectContent to include explicit max-height (max-h-[400px]) and overflow-y-auto classes. Ensure z-index is set to z-50 or higher. Add scroll-behavior-smooth for better UX. Verify SelectScrollUpButton and SelectScrollDownButton components are present. Test keyboard navigation (arrow keys) works properly with SelectItem focus management.

requirements.summary: Diagnose and fix account submission error showing 'failed to add account' when users submit the form with valid data
acceptanceCriteria: Investigate backend actor method for adding accounts (addAccount or similar) in main.mo
Verify account data structure matches frontend submission format
Check for authentication/authorization issues preventing account creation
Ensure proper error handling and meaningful error messages
Fix any data type mismatches between frontend and backend
Successfully added accounts appear immediately in Accounts.tsx dashboard
Success toast displays 'Account added successfully' on successful submission
Form clears and dialog closes after successful account addition

file_operations.description: Review the form submission handler to ensure proper data structure is passed to useAddAccount hook. Verify AccountInput structure matches backend interface: { name: string, accountType: string, balance: number, currency: string }. Add detailed error logging in catch block to capture backend error messages. Ensure propFirm value is assigned to the accountType field (or name field if that's the convention). Add success toast notification using toast.success('Account added successfully'). Clear form fields and close dialog on successful mutation. Add loading state during submission to prevent double-clicks.

Add detailed error handling in the mutation function. Log the full error object and extract meaningful error messages from backend traps. Ensure proper error propagation to the UI component. Add onSuccess callback that invalidates the accounts query cache to trigger immediate refetch. Verify the AccountInput type being passed matches the backend interface definition exactly.

requirements.summary: Update prop firm dropdown in AddAccountDialog to display merged and sorted list of default firms and user's custom-added firms
acceptanceCriteria: Dropdown shows all firms from PROP_FIRMS constant plus user's custom firms
Combined list is alphabetically sorted
Custom firms are visually distinguishable (optional badge or icon)
Search functionality works across both default and custom firms
Dropdown performance remains smooth with combined list

file_operations.description: Create a useMemo hook that merges PROP_FIRMS constant with customPropFirms from user profile. Remove duplicates using Set. Sort the combined array alphabetically using localeCompare. When rendering SelectItem components, check if the firm is from customPropFirms array and conditionally render a Badge or icon (e.g., Star icon) next to custom firm names for visual distinction. Ensure the search filter operates on the merged list. Use the sorted, merged list as the data source for both the Select dropdown and the search filter.
